explication: The repository provides Spark RAPIDS core tools for event-log-based qualification and GPU profiling, plus Python user tools that run them across cloud platforms and report cost/performance guidance. The principal workflow is application/event-log input → event processing and retained application state → SQL-plan and metric analysis → qualification/profiling results and reports. The README documents the product capabilities; sampled source confirms application state and SQL-plan management, but does not expose the full runtime wiring, so uncertain connections are dashed and uncited.
